Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment focuses on the interactome of ZUFSP. The primary comparisons are between wild-type ZUFSP and a catalytically inactive mutant (C360A), and between ZUFSP interactors with and without nuclease treatment to determine DNA-dependence of the interactions. Benzonase is treated as a chemical/drug perturbation (broad category) as it is an exogenous enzyme used to modulate the biological state (DNA presence) during the MS-analyzed sample preparation.
